rows.convert/first: Seconds the first convert of a fresh process takes, timed without the step-by-step breakdown. A caller that opens an adapter and converts once also waits for the engine to start (the boot rows) and the adapter to load (the load rows), which this does not count.
rows.convert/second: Seconds a second convert of the same document takes in the same process, timed without the step-by-step breakdown: the warm cost.
rows.convert/profiled: Seconds of the one convert run with the step-by-step breakdown on, from which the stage and query rows are read. The breakdown makes it slower than a plain convert.
rows.memory.grow/first: How many times the engine's memory grew during the first convert.
rows.memory.grow/second: How many times the engine's memory grew during the second convert.
rows.wasm-memory/first: Bytes of memory the engine holds once the first convert is done.
rows.wasm-memory/second: Bytes of memory the engine holds once the second convert is done.
rows.rss: Peak memory the whole process held in RAM, in bytes: the engine's start, the adapter's load and both converts all count.
rows.records: Source records the Bridge found in the document and converted.
rows.triples: Distinct triples in the output graph.
rows.index-built: 1 when the profiled convert ran a query in compiled form, which needs a lookup structure built over the record's triples; 0 when it did not.
rows.output-bytes/graph: Bytes of the output graph as Turtle.
rows.output-bytes/findings: Bytes of the findings as Turtle.
rows.fallbacks: Record executions the general evaluator answered because a query was not compiled or a compiled plan gave up. The detect query, which runs once, is not counted.
rows.query-time/*: Seconds one of the adapter's queries took, summed over every record it ran on, in the profiled convert.
rows.query-rows/*: Rows one of the adapter's queries returned, summed over every record it ran on.
rows.output/graph: Distinct triples in the output graph, with a SHA-256 fingerprint of the output that is the same whenever the content is the same, whatever order the engine wrote it in and whatever it named its blank nodes.
rows.output/findings: Distinct triples in the findings, with a SHA-256 fingerprint of them that is the same whenever the content is the same, whatever order the engine wrote them in and whatever it named its blank nodes.
rows.load: Seconds to read the adapter's and the vocabulary's files, describe the adapter and prepare it, with the engine already started.
rows.load/read-files: Seconds of the load spent reading files from disk.
rows.load/prepare: Seconds of the load spent describing the adapter and preparing it: parsing and compiling its queries, schemas and shapes.
rows.load/files-read: Files read for the load, the adapter's and the vocabulary's.
rows.load/missing-files: Files the load needed that the adapter's description did not list, which the host read from the folder as the load asked for them.
rows.boot/read-wasm: Seconds to read the engine's compiled code from disk.
rows.boot/compile-wasm: Seconds to turn the engine's compiled code into something the machine can run.
rows.boot/instantiate-wasm: Seconds to start the compiled code, which runs its start-up work.
rows.timeout/*: The input did not finish in its time limit, in the phase named; the value is the limit in seconds.
rows.refused/*: The Bridge refused the input with this kind of failure.
